reason: Reviewed production release for My Pack One Insights Drafting DNA, Your Drafting Journey, and Best Calls & Biggest Misses (#1173, #1167, #1170, #1171). The additive private Growth Insights response now provides deterministic evidence-backed player archetypes (one primary, two secondary slots), chronological original-score windows and selected original-card previews; a new authenticated owner-only read-only original-pack detail route is explicitly allowed through the protected Cloudflare gateway. No existing scoring, Daily/Practice, history, leaderboards or account lifecycle mutations; historical decisions are not regraded or repeated and account-owned first-encounter checks are enforced. Required JS, web browser, mobile validation, gateway/runtime, postgres-contract, and isolated backend account/draft-run/daily/seasons/subscriptions tests passed on feature commit a0c3d6d36de895db7f163713d6e5f3add7f80094; corpus readiness suite is unrelated to changed content and was still running at merge, no failure reported. Deploy reviewed exact main revision via the fixed secure-auth development-before-production Neon and protected first-party gateway workflow, with read-only live smoke and audit. Preserve all production data, identity/session secrets, quota keys and app metadata. This release has NO schema migration, does not change card corpus, does not start Android/iOS builds, does not modify Play/TestFlight tracks, does not submit app review and does not send posts or reminders.
